entities.name: Samurai
entities.description: Creature type of warriors sworn to a single authority figure, usually a feudal lord; also called Bushi or musha.

entities.name: Ronin
entities.description: Samurai who lost honor or their lord and became rogues.

entities.name: Tetsuo, Imperial Champion
entities.description: Samurai explicitly from a plane other than Kamigawa.

relations.note: Ronin are samurai who lost their lord or honor.
relations.quote: Due to personal dishonor or the death of their lord, some samurai become rogues called ronin
